'''Corana''' is an [[Aiel]] ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]''. She thinks of [[Rand al'Thor]] as an older brother.

== Appearance ==
She is an older Maiden with graying hair. 

== Activities ==
She accompanies Rand when he Travels to Caemlyn after he had been captured by the [[White Tower]] [[Aes Sedai]].

She goes with [[Davram Bashere]] and [[Damer Flinn]] when they go to the [[Daughter of the Nine Moons]] to request her to have a meeting with Rand.
